channel.title: InvestPR Media Monitoring
channel.description: Outside investment led the period: PharmaEssentia of Taiwan committed about $46M to a Toa Baja biomanufacturing plant, and an InvestPR trade mission is courting four more Taiwanese firms. Metropistas (Abertis) plans $120M in a second phase of toll-road repairs, AES's $1.2B Marajú Solar project is moving toward operation, Polaris is advancing a roughly $60M Punta Lima storage project, and Global Ports Holding is modernizing the San Juan cruise port. PRAK Industries (SNC Technical Services, Alaska) is expanding in Aibonito with a $1.2M investment, and Marriott's City Centro brand has chosen a Ponce hotel. Risks center on energy costs: rates are up 18.5% to 33.85 cents/kWh, a UPR study shows costs up 37% in five years, PREPA creditor litigation continues, and Liberty Puerto Rico's rating was cut to CCC with default seen as likely.
